recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key portrait of a woman with golden blonde curls looking over her shoulder, wearing a voluminous purple gown that dissolves into watercolor textures and sparkling particles against a stark white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's skin tones against the vibrant magenta-purple fabric
Solid photographic realism blending into abstract watercolor splashes
Dynamic diagonal movement of the dress fabric across the lower two-thirds
Contrast between the sharp focus on the face and the soft, painterly edges of the gown
coreInvariants: Vibrant purple and magenta color palette for the garment
Over-the-shoulder pose with direct eye contact

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered horizontally, occupying the upper half of the frame; the dress expands to fill the bottom half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and red lips provide the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, follows the line of the shoulder down to the sweeping motion of the dress, and circles back through the script lettering.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white negative space in the upper corners emphasizes the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the purples against a high-value white background creates a clean, pop-art sensibility.
paletteRestrictions: Maintain high brightness in the white fields

letterConstructionRules: Monolinear stroke weight for the primary title
Extended flourishes and swashes that overlap the subject
Hand-drawn, informal quality with varying baseline
characterSpecificRedesigns: Ascenders and descenders elongated to create movement
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, white monoline script paired with a smaller, gold-toned elegant cursive signature-style font.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, airy feel of the watercolor elements
Similar bouncy baseline and long connections

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A portrait of a woman with curly blonde hair looking over her shoulder, wearing a flowing purple gown. The bottom of the dress should transition into magenta watercolor splashes and white glitter particles against a solid white background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, white, hand-drawn monoline script title across the lower third, angled upwards. Below it, add a smaller signature-style text in a gold-yellow hue.

verificationChecks: Does the dress blend into watercolor textures?
Is the text legible despite the overlap?

adjustableVariables: Shade of purple (from lavender to deep plum)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features to avoid likeness
Unique lettering shapes to avoid brand infringement

mustAchieve: Fluid sense of motion in the fabric
Seamless blend between photo and illustration

postGenerationChecks: Check for smooth gradients in the purple fabric
Ensure the white text has enough contrast against the purple
Verify the watercolor effect looks organic and not digitally tiled
Confirm the high-key lighting doesn't wash out the skin tones
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key portrait + [Subject Description] + [Garment Color] flowing gown + watercolor splash integration + monoline script overlay.
